resources.string: What Verified, Estimated and App time only mean
Usage access, pause, tracked apps and estimates
Who can see your activity, online status and blocked accounts
Your profile, photo, friends and all saved figures are permanently deleted, on Android and iPhone. This can\'t be undone.
Can\'t reach ReelCounter. Check your connection and try again.
Something went wrong, so nothing was deleted. Please try again.
You can sign back in any time with your email and password.
ReelCounter uses only what your phone already records and what platforms officially share. Every number is labeled with where it came from.
Counted by the platform itself and shared with your permission. Only some platforms offer this, and only in some regions.
Counted one by one on your phone: each time a new video fills the screen in the app\'s short-video feed, ReelCounter adds one. This needs reel counting turned on in Tracking & apps.
Worked out from how long the app was open, using assumptions about how much of that time is reels and how long each one lasts. You can adjust the assumptions. Estimates always show a likely range.
How long the app was open. Where reels are a small or varied part of an app, we show the time without guessing a count.
Nothing could be measured, for example because usage access is off, tracking is paused, or the app was used on the web.
Why app time isn\'t reels time
Android reports how long an app was on screen, not which part of it you were using. Time in Instagram, for example, includes the feed, Stories and messages as well as Reels.
